descriptionByLocale.en: Place of work: Hirslanden Clinic Stephanshorn | St. Gallen Occupation by: by appointment Type of employment: Permanent Reference number: 68216 As the largest medical network in Switzerland, we set standards with our clinics, outpatient surgery centers and emergency departments. Nursing specialist HF - Several years of experience in the surgical environment/acute hospital - Very good IT user knowledge - Structured, efficient and independent way of working - High resilience and strong organizational skills - Very good knowledge of German (at least B2) OTHER SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE - High ability to concentrate and work precisely even under time pressure and during interruptions - Strong sense of responsibility and networked thinking - High social skills and empathy in dealing with Patients - Ability to work in a team and interdisciplinary collaboration - Ability to work efficiently both independently and in a team SPECIAL FEATURES - Challenging, cognitively influenced work with a high level of personal responsibility Would you like to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can fully develop your strengths, know-how and skills? We create an inspiring environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and you have the chance to have a positive impact on people's well-being. OUR OFFER - Motivated, innovative and experienced team - Regular working hours - Possibility of up to 7 weeks of vacation per year with the "Leisure Plus" model - Paid changing time in the form of up to 4 additional days off - Free coffee, tea and mineral water - Restaurant with up to 50% discount - Public transport subsidy of 75% on the annual subscription - Interesting career and development opportunities - Further information about our benefits can be found HERE For additional information Please contact Monica Sofia Goncalves Venezia, TL PAS, at Monica.Goncalves@hirslanden.ch or Sina Angela Sieber at sinaangela.sieber@hirslanden.ch, HR Business Partner.
